entries.name: MakerspaceURI
entries.what_it_is: Free to every student. 3D printers, laser cutter, CNC router, 3D scanner, with SolidWorks and Rhino loaded on the machines.
entries.how_to_join: Walk in. Bring a project rather than a single print.

entries.name: Rhody Esports Club & the Esports eLab
entries.what_it_is: A dedicated room with gaming PCs and real internet, plus a club that runs on Discord.
entries.how_to_join: Discord-first, so you can lurk before showing up in person.

entries.name: Ram Hacks
entries.what_it_is: Campus hackathon group. Twenty-four to forty-eight hours, a team, and a real thing that exists by the end.
entries.how_to_join: Sign up for the next event. Teams form on the day.
entries.fills_gap: collaborative - for students whose listed projects are all solo

entries.name: Innovation Labs
entries.what_it_is: Credit-bearing project work built around exactly this kind of making.
